outcome: Infant overweight and obesity at one year of age
cohort: Infants attending Primary Health Centers in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, in 2019
finding: Caesarean delivery and having ≤4 siblings were associated with infant overweight and obesity at one year of age, while breastfeeding was associated with lower odds of overweight and obesity.
mod_finding: Infant overweight and obesity at one year of age was associated with a greater likelihood of cesarean mode of delivery.
